Villa 79 Walkthrough

Villa 79

Nexon Travenza · 30 × 40 East · corner plot

In the headset: left stick walks, right stick turns. A or trigger goes to the next room, B or grip goes back. X or Y switches between the 30 × 40 and 30 × 50 villa, keeping you in the same room. Press a stick in to hide or show the floor tapes.

VR starts only in a headset browser that allows it for this page. If the button stays off in your Quest, open the standalone copy of this page there.
